newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Horizon Pharmacies Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Horizon Pharmacies Inc.

text.p: Lead Underwriter Capital West Securities Inc
NOTE: All shares to be sold by company.
Business: Owns and operates a chain of 14 retail pharmacies -- nine in Texas, two in Virginia, one in New Mexico, one in Oklahoma and one in Wisconsin.

Use of proceeds: To repay certain existing indebtness, acquire additional retail pharmacies and/or the inventory and pharmacy files of other retail pharmacies, make a distribution to existing shareholders and for general corporate purposes, including working capital.
